0022600101.text: The Grizzlies (1-0, 2nd in the Southwest and 6th in the West) are looking to build on a home win and face the Golden State Warriors (0-1, 3rd in the Pacific and 1 game back, 13th in the West), who are 0-1 on the road. Memphis is without Cedric Coward (wrist sprain), while Golden State is missing Charles Bassey (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Grizzlies lost 0-3 to the Warriors, including a 133-112 loss in Memphis on February 25, 2026.
